stem: A student used f(x) = 5.00(1.012)^x to show how the balance in a savings account will increase over time. What does the 5.00 represent?

options.label: A
options.text: The interest the savings account earned for the first year

options.label: B
options.text: The annual interest rate of the savings account

options.label: C
options.text: The number of years the savings account has earned interest

options.label: D
options.text: The starting balance of the savings account
